lead: Mohamed Muizzu is a politician, born on 15 June 1978 in Malé.
As of 2026, he is 48 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has held the office of President of the Maldives and Mayor of Malé.
The sections that follow break down Mohamed Muizzu's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Mohamed Muizzu — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mohamed Muizzu was born on 15 June 1978 in Malé, and holds citizenship of Maldives.
Public records name his father, Hussain Abdul Rahman.
He studied at University of London, University of Leeds, Majeediyya School and Iskandhar School.
He is recorded as speaking Maldivian and English.

sections.heading: Mohamed Muizzu — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and engineer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: President of the Maldives (2023–present), Mayor of Malé (2021–2023), Minister of Housing and Infrastructure (2012–2018), Minister of Housing and Environment (2012–2012), President-elect of the Maldives (2023–2023) and president (2023–present). He is affiliated with Adhaalath Party.
He has taken part in Muizzu-Eesha Scandal.

sections.heading: Mohamed Muizzu — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Sajidha Mohamed (married 2003).
He is a parent to Umyr Mohamed Muizzu.
He is associated with Mulee'aage and Dhimyaath as a place of residence.
